title: Single-cell spatial mapping of human kidney development implicates the microenvironment in guiding cell fate decisions.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: GEO file lists for both series: GSE277893 = 5 fetal kidney scRNA-seq (single-cell RNA sequencing) samples as 10x barcodes/features/mtx files (486 MB tar); GSE278614 = 3 CosMx spatial h5ad files (792, 324, 261 MB; 1.3 GB tar) plus a summary file. Read the obs table of GSM8551264_HK3524_raw.h5ad by HTTP range requests (31 MB transferred): 118,197 cells x 995 genes, obs columns only Area, CenterX/Y_global_px, cell_ID, fov (69), gAge (single value 19), sample, tech; obsm and uns empty, so no cell-type, lineage, neighbourhood or trajectory labels. Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.20529508 holds only a 12 MB code zip; the GitHub repo tree is scripts and notebooks only.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The >700,000 cell total (which must include integrated cells beyond these 8 deposited samples), the Xenium data (no Xenium series found in GEO), and that cell types were assigned by scANVI/Leiden clustering and marker-gene annotation of expression. Contents of the 5 scRNA-seq mtx files and the 2 larger CosMx h5ad files were not opened.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked: GEO GSE277893 and GSE278614 are public, no login; processed matrices and h5ad files download. Raw reads withheld for privacy, which does not matter here.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked in the HK3524 h5ad: no cell-type, lineage-probability, niche or fate column exists. Every candidate label (cell type, fate, neighbourhood) would have to be rebuilt by re-running the authors' clustering and annotation pipeline from GitHub.

a3_inputs_present.note: Checked: count matrices and spatial coordinates are present in the files, gene symbols in var.

a4_units_stated.note: Raw counts plus pixel coordinates; units implicit but standard for CosMx/10x.

a5_enough_rows.note: 118,197 cells in one CosMx sample (verified), but cells are not independent: there are only 5 scRNA-seq donors and 3 CosMx tissues in GEO, and the HK3524 file carries a single gestational age. Any donor- or tissue-level question has n = 3 to 8.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~1.8 GB of h5ad and mtx files
a6_fits_laptop.note: Sparse matrices of ~1,000 CosMx genes fit in 16 GB if loaded one sample at a time.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Paper says >700,000 cells and includes Xenium; GEO holds 8 samples and no Xenium series, so the deposited data are a subset and the paper's count cannot be reproduced from the files.

a8_label_provenance.note: Cell types and fates in the paper come from clustering, scANVI (a semi-supervised neural label-transfer model) and CellRank (a trajectory model) applied to the same expression, so predicting them from expression is circular.

backbone.name: scGPT or Geneformer (single-cell foundation models); CosMx's ~1,000-gene panel covers only part of their vocabulary
backbone.hardware: CPU feasible for embeddings of ~100k cells, slow

integration.partner_dataset: Human Nephrogenesis Atlas (Flatiron) or the CELLxGENE kidney atlases
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Could not be written without labels in the deposited files; a cross-atlas annotation transfer would just reproduce existing label-transfer work.

controls.positive_control: Marker genes (SIX2 for nephron progenitors) should localise to the cortical edge in CosMx coordinates.
controls.negative_control: Shuffle spatial coordinates within each field of view.
controls.external_validation: None among the deposited files; would need another lab's fetal kidney spatial data.

honest_claim_h3: At best: predicts a cell's annotated type or neighbourhood from its own and its neighbours' expression in 2 fetal and 1 further kidney section, where the annotation itself came from clustering the same expression.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use the gene activity of a cell's spatial neighbours in fetal kidney tissue to predict which developmental fate that cell adopts.
plain_idea.train_on: Each cell's measured RNA counts for ~995 genes plus those of its neighbours in CosMx tissue sections; 118,197 cells in one verified sample, 3 tissue sections total.
plain_idea.predict: The cell's fate or type, but no such label is deposited; it would come from the authors' clustering and trajectory software run on the same RNA counts, not from an independent measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Developmental biologists would learn which niche signals steer kidney progenitors, but here the model would mostly relearn the authors' clustering.

ml_idea: Niche-to-fate prediction on CosMx fetal kidney: graph model over spatial neighbours predicting cell type or lineage probability. Rejected because labels are absent from the deposited files and would be clustering/scANVI/CellRank outputs computed from the same expression.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from verified file sizes (h5ad 261-792 MB, mtx 56-134 MB each); feature-table hours assume re-running the authors' annotation pipeline. Nothing timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Done: read the h5ad obs columns; no cell-type or fate column, single gestational age, 3 spatial tissues.

verdict_reason: Fails A2 and A8: the deposited CosMx h5ad has only coordinates, field of view and a single gestational age, with no cell-type or fate labels, and the paper's labels are clustering/scANVI/CellRank outputs computed from the same expression. Only 5 scRNA-seq donors and 3 spatial tissues are in GEO (A5 at the donor level), and the >700,000-cell and Xenium data are not all deposited (A7).
